## Design step 1 landed: framework skeleton

The framework design record is open for review: **`doc/2026-11-08_design_id5683.md`** via **PR #7781** (522 lines, docs-only).

It covers the declaration/evidence model with assurance levels, public-IP-as-evidence limits, sanctions boundaries as versioned data with grandfathering and appeals, intranet mode with step-up and org-escrow proxying, intersection-only composability, and per-surface enforcement. It reuses `pkgs/id/crates/id-core/src/residency.rs` unchanged and extends it additively.

### Implementation issues filed from the decomposition (design §12)

| Step | Issue |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Evidence assurance layer | #7783 |
| 2. Declaration record and invariants | #7782 |
| 3. Public-IP evidence derivation | #7784 |
| 4. Sanctions list data model | #7785 |
| 5. Intranet-mode gating, step-up, org escrow | #7786 |
| 6. Surface wiring (signup/login, worlds, federation) | #7787 |

Each is self-contained with its own acceptance criteria and cites the design section it implements. None is implemented by the design PR.

### Notes

- Drew's framing is restated in design §1 as hard requirements so children cite rather than re-derive it: capabilities-never-defaults, basic-frameworks-first, not a GDPR product.
